notes: This is a single-column Bulgarian entomology journal in the old orthography. Body lines (1-20, 32-40) read correctly, including ѣ, ж and ъ, and the column_crossing flags on page 150 are false: those are ordinary full-width lines. The English and German lines (22, 25, 29, 30) are real bilingual article titles and match the print. Minor errors: the display-font capital Ѣ is read as Ь in two headings (21 'ВРЕДНИТЬ', 28 'НИТЬ'), standalone 'сж' is read as 'ся' (8), and '6' as 'б' (3). These are too few to warrant a pattern. A pool-wide rule that maps standalone 'ся' to 'сж' in pre-1945 Bulgarian books could be considered.
